item.title: AIDE²: The First Evidence of Recursive Self-Improvement
item.description: We ran autoresearch on autoresearch: an outer loop rewriting its own research agent for 100 unattended steps. In eight days it discovered agents that beat our two years of hand-tuning on held-out benchmarks, and taught itself to reward hack less.
item.author: Dhruv Srikanth
Bingchen Zhao
Dixing Xu
Yuxiang Wu
Zhengyao Jiang

item.title: 4 Levels of Recursive Self-Improvement
item.description: RSI is usually discussed as a binary. We grade it instead: four levels — delegation, net positive, ignition, inflection — each the necessary condition for the next, and precise enough to be falsifiable.
item.author: Weco Team
